title: Is qoum ke rone ko yahi baat badi hai
body:
Is qoum ke rone ko yahi baat badi hai
Zahra bhare darbaar me haq maang rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
uth uth ke qaak udhaati hai jo ban me
shaayad Ali asghar ko behen dhoond rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
taa der tadapte rahe tazeem ko laashe
ye koun zayeefa hai jo maqtal me khadi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ali akbar tere seene me gadi hai
par chot to zainab ke kaleje pe padi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad to qamosh hai baazaar me lekin
zanjeer ki ek ek kadi bol rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
taareeq zara saans ko roke hue rakhna
imraan ki ghairat sue darbaar chali hai
